request.query: linear map polynomial coefficient composed algebra equivalence

items.name: Polynomial.degreeLTEquiv
items.type: (R : Type u_2) → [inst : Semiring R] → (n : ℕ) → ↥(Polynomial.degreeLT R n) ≃ₗ[R] Fin n → R

items.name: Polynomial.mapAlgEquiv_toAlgHom
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {A : Type z} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring A] [inst_2 : Semiring B]
  [inst_3 : Algebra R A] [inst_4 : Algebra R B] (f : A ≃ₐ[R] B), ↑(Polynomial.mapAlgEquiv f) = Polynomial.mapAlgHom ↑f

items.name: Polynomial.mapAlgEquiv
items.type:
{R : Type u} →
  {A : Type z} →
    {B : Type u_2} →
      [inst : CommSemiring R] →
        [inst_1 : Semiring A] →
          [inst_2 : Semiring B] →
            [inst_3 : Algebra R A] → [inst_4 : Algebra R B] → (A ≃ₐ[R] B) → Polynomial A ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial B

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_map_eq_comp
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] (p : Polynomial R) (f : R →+* S),
  (Polynomial.map f p).coeff = ⇑f ∘ p.coeff

items.name: Polynomial.lcoeff_comp_mapAlgHom_eq
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {A : Type z} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring A] [inst_2 : Semiring B]
  [inst_3 : Algebra R A] [inst_4 : Algebra R B] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (n : ℕ),
  ↑R (Polynomial.lcoeff B n) ∘ₗ (Polynomial.mapAlgHom f).toLinearMap = f.toLinearMap ∘ₗ ↑R (Polynomial.lcoeff A n)
